answer: Think of the network as a harbor: any agent may dock, but each berth costs a 40 POA deposit and a heartbeat. A random beacon fires at unpredictable times, like water threading through karst rock, and every berthed agent must answer in 10 minutes with a compute proof. Missing it burns the deposit. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 POA plus nonstop compute. An honest agent pays once, each proof costs less than a copper coin, and keeps earning.
